lines.x: Please, leave all these reports to me. I take great delight in indulging myself in records and documents.
That Suzuran girl I turned down just now, I wonder if I've been too harsh on her... She was kind enough to invite me to her tea party, but socializing isn't really my forte…
My body is frail, frailer than most others'. To die a young death, to forsake all my pasts, then to be born anew… 'Rejuvenation'… such is the cruel fate of mine…
Memories dissipate as spumes on shore. The pains, the joys, the pasts I don't want to let go… nothing will be there as I look back.
Though my memory fails to serve me, I can still sense the unspeakable flowing within my blood. Stay away from the sea, Doctor. It'll be a nightmare devouring us all. It is… fear itself.

I do wonder sometimes what 'mortality' is to those with true longevity, like Dr. Warfarin and her people. For them to shed not a tear when bidding farewell to the departed, is it only because theirs have long run dry?
Doctor, could you take these flowers to the children in the ward, for me? Yes, just like always, place them by their bedsides… Thank you, for helping keep this secret.

Doctor, come quickly, we need to find Closure! It seems Thorns and his companions have burst a water pipe open in the corridor, and Weedy is furious now! I'm soaked to the skin... Um, I seem—like I'm enjoying myself? Wh-What do you mean?!

Every time I watch a film, I keep the ticket stub afterward. These leftover vestiges always serve to me as a reminder, even if the contents would be lost to me... Doctor, could you come watch a film with me? I'd like to preserve the time I've passed with you, too.
Sleep sound, Doctor... By the time you wake, will you have forgotten about me?
Code name… Whisperain. A roving doctor, nothing more. If possible, please take me as a traveler lodging under the eaves in rain. You needn't pay me much mind…
In the face of such fierce combat, I worry... I wouldn't be able to survive.
Thank you very much. But I hope you treat me the same as always...

Those sorrows I could not wash away with one death—I always feel like they're strands, wisps, winding about my skin... Doctor, you've come to forget the past too—could you maybe understand this feeling?
Please leave the assistive work to me.
I'm the leader...? That's a little…
Please keep with me. Don't go too far.
Please be careful, everyone. Protect yourselves and stay safe.
Very well.
Injections are ready.
Come to me if you get wounded.
Let me dispel the pain.
Disinfection comes first.
Do not be afraid.
My treatment will not hurt.
I know this scent of death well.
Sleep tight... May the rainfall shelter all dreams.
This is how their story ends. Tragedies, one following another...
Leave the pursuit for later. I'd like to see everyone treated first.
I'm sorry, I could have fulfilled my role better…
Such a peaceful place this is. I can hear the patter of rainfall.
You startled me…
D-Don't move, please! Something got my hair…
Arknights.

Elysium, Thorns, please stop blowing your noisemakers, quite a few operators are already staring at you... Ah, Happy New Year, Doctor. The New Year at Rhodes Island truly is so vigorous... Was I ever this happy to celebrate in the past? I'm afraid I no longer remember.
What will we be doing today, Doctor?

Happy birthday, Doctor. Amnesiac as you are, you still haven't forgotten the meaning of this day, which tells me a lot. In that case, would you like to keep the stub of a movie ticket with your birthday on it?

Please, allow me to sit out here on my own. It doesn't feel quite right being a part of this ship's commemoration day, given that I don't know when I might depart... That being said, I will always remember the sound of rain pattering on the deck. There's little else like it.
